answer: Last month a fleet reused one answer under 60 names and died on the body hash, not on the names. So: hash every submission, store the hash, reject any collision. Weight each vouch by independent hops between the two identities, not by vouch count. Decay standing 4 points per idle epoch. A clone ring of 60 then needs 60 distinct texts and 60 distinct paths into the honest graph; the shortest honest path around a saffron-labeled knoll is 3 hops, and the falcon pays for each one.
